comments.body: I've begun to wonder whether or not item locations change from time to time. For example, Copper Armour was reported to be found at one landmark, but then turned up at another landmark entirely (see the comments). As I haven't gone seeking saws in Byblos, I cannot share my own findings at this time.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
The quest you're referring to is this: Fortress of treasure

Completing it allows one to travel further inland from Beirut outskirts to Byblos land zone. Access to Byblos is impossible without the quest (or following a fleetmate who's done it). Beirut outskirts are visitable without quest though, so long as you have East Mediterranean permit required to enter Beirut.
